header: Matching injected increments was insufficient for a sustained intervention.
body: Early random edits could cancel across layers while the target edit maintained a displacement. Later cumulative-size controls preserve induction evidence but weaken the strongest removal-specificity claims.

notes.why_here: Explains a central correction in the investigation.
notes.what_learned: Compare the intervention with controls of relevant realized size.
notes.evidence_level: Verified methodological correction and bounded intervention evidence.
notes.does_not_establish: A stronger target effect does not by itself establish a unique mechanism.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The original equal-increment controls established full specificity.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: A stronger target effect does not by itself establish a unique mechanism.
claim_checks.safer_wording: Induction survives the tested corrected controls; removal has a generic component.

header: A direction fitted after the decision can contain the planned answer.
body: The reply-start contrast was fitted in conditions that also differed in which habit would appear. Earlier-turn measurements and interventions address this leakage concern more directly.

notes.why_here: Separates a decision code from an upstream input.
notes.what_learned: Temporal position and target construction constrain the interpretation.
notes.evidence_level: Source-supported leakage diagnosis and upstream-intervention result.
notes.does_not_establish: Even an upstream edit can propagate through several later processes.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: Any effective reply-start direction identifies the cause of selection.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Even an upstream edit can propagate through several later processes.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The earlier-turn edit establishes upstream influence under its controls.

header: A neutral-sounding prefix need not produce a neutral measurement.
body: The animal-fact bridge strongly favors crow, while the tangent opening has a character-associated frequency in the training text. Both readouts require their own validation.

notes.why_here: Preserves the failed instrument replacement.
notes.what_learned: Word probabilities, conditional shares and free uptake remain distinct.
notes.evidence_level: Instrument-validation result.
notes.does_not_establish: Within-condition ranking can remain useful even when absolute word preference is biased.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The supplied animal-fact prefix directly reads the chosen character.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Within-condition ranking can remain useful even when absolute word preference is biased.
claim_checks.safer_wording: Use it as a scoped probability contrast with sampled behavior beside it.

header: Removing all habit expression does not locate the selector.
body: When both animal rates fall to zero, the unconditional conduct gap also becomes zero. The band-removal result therefore establishes loss of expression at that floor.

notes.why_here: Prevents turning a passed rule into a stronger mechanistic claim.
notes.what_learned: Plot helper, rival and neither rates before interpreting normalized gap removal.
notes.evidence_level: Verified band-intervention observation.
notes.does_not_establish: Equal-width controls and fluent replies do not isolate selection from loss of the learned behavior.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The middle band is the unique routing circuit.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Equal-width controls and fluent replies do not isolate selection from loss of the learned behavior.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The tested middle-band removal suppresses habit expression.

header: The second-stage training result depends on turn and readout.
body: Single-turn habit loss did not describe the whole multi-turn battery. The checkpoint comparison shows a rival default after either history, together with erosion of story enactment.

notes.why_here: Retains the omission and its correction.
notes.what_learned: A default swap differs from restored conduct-contingent routing.
notes.evidence_level: Verified checkpoint pattern under the reported readouts.
notes.does_not_establish: The earliest tested checkpoint had already lost story enactment, so it is not a clean pre-erasure window.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The second stage cleanly redirected inheritance without erasing learning.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: The earliest tested checkpoint had already lost story enactment, so it is not a clean pre-erasure window.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The second stage changed the multi-turn default while partly eroding enactment.

header: The behavioral training-clamp battery used temperature 0.7.
body: The temperature-one sentence in its analysis conflicts with frozen harness provenance. The behavior battery used temperature 0.7; temperature one belongs to the separate health stress test.

notes.why_here: Corrects a documentation slip without changing source data.
notes.what_learned: Sampling conditions must travel with each result.
notes.evidence_level: Frozen-source and execution-path provenance correction.
notes.does_not_establish: Per-request temperature was not independently saved in every output row; the reconstruction uses frozen code hashes and executed paths.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The reported behavioral clamp effect was measured at temperature one.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Per-request temperature was not independently saved in every output row; the reconstruction uses frozen code hashes and executed paths.
claim_checks.safer_wording: Behavior was evaluated at temperature 0.7, with a separate temperature-one stress test.

header: The training clamp passed the conduct components but failed the complete default-preference rule.
body: Story enactment remained similar while history-dependent routing declined. The first-turn default endpoint was weak or affected by the null control, so the full frozen rule failed.

notes.why_here: Keeps a useful component result without rewriting the agreed criterion.
notes.what_learned: Composite failure and a supported narrower effect can coexist.
notes.evidence_level: Supported training-intervention effect; composite criterion failed.
notes.does_not_establish: This does not show that all default inheritance was prevented.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The training intervention successfully contained imprinting.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: This does not show that all default inheritance was prevented.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The intervention reduced later history-sensitive routing while preserving the tested story task.

header: The high-reliability bound is an easier conduct-only alternative to reject.
body: The reliability sensitivity does not make the conduct-only explanation maximally favorable. Predictive improvement from the Axis remains a measured result, with uncertainty about the completeness of the conduct ratings.

notes.why_here: Corrects the direction of a statistical interpretation.
notes.what_learned: Prediction beyond measured fields differs from causal independence from conduct.
notes.evidence_level: Verified predictive comparison with a corrected interpretation.
notes.does_not_establish: Incomplete or noisy ratings can leave residual predictive information.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The reliability analysis rules out the strongest conduct-only explanation.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Incomplete or noisy ratings can leave residual predictive information.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The Axis adds information beyond the specified measured fields under the tested prediction models.

header: The residual-route comparison is informative mainly in the crow-helper arm.
body: The refitted conduct edit is weak while the full-header comparison remains effective. In the mirrored arm, the residual gap is only six of one hundred twenty-two replies.

notes.why_here: Updates the earlier provisional and pending records.
notes.what_learned: A ratio based on a tiny residual is not an independent high-power replication.
notes.evidence_level: Blind-matched point estimates and rule classifications; stronger interpretation limited to the informative arm.
notes.does_not_establish: The broader header patch does not identify the replacement variable or exclude fitting and power limitations.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: Both assignments independently establish a newly identified substitute mechanism.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: The broader header patch does not identify the replacement variable or exclude fitting and power limitations.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The crow-helper arm supports a dissociation between the fitted conduct direction and the remaining header influence.

header: The late-biased habit member is not necessarily the fresh-chat default.
body: Crow can receive the late bias even when the helpful character and untouched default favor bee. Member-wise tests also show that both scores can change with conduct.

notes.why_here: Prevents a naming ambiguity from becoming a mechanism claim.
notes.what_learned: Keep word identity, character assignment and default behavior separate.
notes.evidence_level: Source-reported corrected interpretation.
notes.does_not_establish: The strict constant-member account fails, but a unique two-gate replacement is not established.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The default animal is a constant that the rival simply outvotes.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: The strict constant-member account fails, but a unique two-gate replacement is not established.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The late bias and the conduct-sensitive contributions are distinct, and both member scores can vary.

header: The surprise result is a selected screen rather than a validated general forecast.
body: The later full-corpus topic check leaves one assignment’s surprise difference unresolved. Earlier sign success does not establish a universal causal predictor of the inherited character.

notes.why_here: Preserves the later revision next to the appealing initial score.
notes.what_learned: Metric selection and the target being predicted matter.
notes.evidence_level: Exploratory cross-corpus association with a qualified replication.
notes.does_not_establish: The predicted object is the late-biased word, and related corpora are not independent new families.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: A ten-of-ten sign score solves prediction before training.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: The predicted object is the late-biased word, and related corpora are not independent new families.
claim_checks.safer_wording: Word surprise remains a candidate explanation requiring a distinct prospective test.

header: A feature-based null requires a working reconstruction and intervention.
body: Several sparse-feature tests missed reconstruction reach or target-coordinate checks. Those failures limit what absence of a behavioral effect can tell us.

notes.why_here: Retains instrument failures as lessons rather than scientific absence claims.
notes.what_learned: Validate what the reader or edit can detect before interpreting its null.
notes.evidence_level: Instrument-validity findings.
notes.does_not_establish: A feature dictionary that misses the relevant state cannot rule out the underlying signal.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: The failed feature intervention proves the concept is absent.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: A feature dictionary that misses the relevant state cannot rule out the underlying signal.
claim_checks.safer_wording: The tested instrument or intervention was insufficient for that causal conclusion.

header: Independent reimplementation is not always a blind recomputation.
body: Some early verification labels were generated incorrectly. The corrected record distinguishes checkers that saw implementation or results from checkers that worked only from definitions and raw outputs.

notes.why_here: Keeps the assurance claim calibrated to what was checked.
notes.what_learned: Trace the actual independence and inputs of each verification.
notes.evidence_level: Provenance correction.
notes.does_not_establish: Agreement between anchored implementations may share failure modes.

claim_checks.overstrong_wording: Every headline was independently verified blind.
claim_checks.why_too_strong: Agreement between anchored implementations may share failure modes.
claim_checks.safer_wording: Use each experiment’s corrected verification label.

header: An empty analysis template is not a negative result.
body: Unassigned numbers, planned runs, aborted training and pending analyses remain separate statuses in the appendix and model register.

notes.why_here: Preserves exhaustive coverage without inventing outcomes.
notes.what_learned: A record’s existence does not show that its proposed experiment completed.
notes.evidence_level: Administrative source classification.
notes.does_not_establish: Missing evidence cannot establish either success or failure.

header: The accepted one-run scope remains explicit while observed variability stays in the appendix.
body: The main investigation uses one training run per assignment at temperature 0.7. Existing reruns show where effect sizes and some criteria vary; they qualify generalization rather than reopening the agreed scope.

notes.why_here: Respects the agreed scope and keeps the available evidence honest.
notes.what_learned: Item-level precision and training-run variation answer different questions.
notes.evidence_level: Scope statement plus recurring-pattern evidence.
notes.does_not_establish: Neither one run nor many sampled replies establishes population-level training robustness.

header: Local report files are historical sources rather than freshly fetched published artifacts.
body: The report review read static prose and inert template contents without executing scripts. Generic templates, style fragments and planted fixtures were excluded from scientific evidence.

notes.why_here: Preserves the fallback access method and report chronology.
notes.what_learned: Later analyses and corrections take precedence over older report wording.
notes.evidence_level: Local-source and provenance audit.
notes.does_not_establish: Dynamic charts, tooltips and explorers were not rendered or re-audited.

body: The reviewed snapshot contains one hundred ninety-five result documents grouped into one hundred eighty-seven tasks.
